title: Divergence: lower_contract_expr (contract-TV production column) omits spec_fn_param_types — TV checks a non-production u64-cast lowering for u32/usize spec-call args (contract-tv.md REQ-2 verbatim miss)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_cast_unthreaded_paths.rs::contract_tv_production_column_matches_real_signature_lowering demonstrates the divergence (run with --ignored; FAILS: lower_contract_expr emits result == s_dec((n - 1) as u64) where the real post-#225 signature lowering emits as u32). Authority: .design/verified/contract-tv.md REQ-2 — 'The production side reuses lower_fn_signature in lower.rs's clause output verbatim (the artifact under test)'. lower_contract_expr has no spec_fn_param_types input and forge::contract_tv::tv_clause passes none, so forge tv discharges a NON-production predicate for u32/usize spec-call-arith clauses. Observable today: honest Unverifiable (not a wrong verdict) because contract_tv's SpecType::BoundedInt frames every int param as u64, so the u32 spec_defs type-clash first (live: forge tv on a u32 s_dec fixture -> ens clauses Unverifiable, reqs faithful). The reference encoder (ref_encode.rs encode_call case 3 / encode_call_arg) emits NO narrowing cast on arith args at all — when the generator extends the frame to u32, both the production column threading AND the reference/frame typing need the declared-param-type rule or every such clause stays Unverifiable. The lower_contract_expr doc comment's byte-identity claim is stale on this clause class.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: commit the three failing critic pins (thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_cast_unthreaded_paths.rs, all #[ignore]d with tracking refs #227/#228) to main as the audit artifact; no production code touched (critic role).
